messages:
Kai: Hi all, I'm Kai (first week). Need quick help: need GCP project `ml-sandbox-3` viewer + `iam.serviceAccountUser` on `gha-sa@ml-sandbox-3.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, and ability to assume AWS role `arn:aws:iam::777888999000:role/RedwoodDevReadOnly` so CI can pull logs. I opened the project and got a 403 on IAM. Who should I ping?

ops: Welcome Kai! Please paste the project ID (looks right) and your @redwood email. Also run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy ml-sandbox-3 --format=json` and paste the redacted bindings. For AWS we'll need your SSO principal name.

Kai: Project ID `ml-sandbox-3`. Email kai@redwood.com. SSO: redwood/kai. Here is the redacted IAM snippet: "bindings: [{role: \"roles/editor\", members: [\"group:sandbox-admins@redwood.com\"]}]" — no direct user bindings.

ops: Got it. ml-sandbox-3 is under folder `sandbox` with restrictResourceLocations set to `[europe-west1, us-central1]`, so APAC regions are blocked. For immediate CI runs in ap-southeast-1 we can do a 24h project exception. Do you need to create resources or only impersonate the SA?

Kai: Just need to impersonate the SA for GitHub Actions and run a one-off test VM in ap-southeast-1. Temporary exception is fine.

ops: OK I'll open ticket CLOUD-8733 to request: add kai@redwood.com to `sandbox-iam-viewers`, grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the SA, and add `ap-southeast-1` to allowed locations for 24h. Also will request AWS group add to `crossacct-readonly`.

cloud-ops-bot: Ticket CLOUD-8733 created and assigned to infra. ETA ~8 business hours. Temporary group `onboard-temp` will be created after approval. :robot_face:

billing-team: FYI temporary region exceptions under 24h are pre-approved up to $10. If you plan sustained usage open FIN ticket.

Kai: Great, thanks. I'll wait for CLOUD-8733 and try the assume-role test once the group is added. Will paste CLI outputs if anything fails. :wave:
